name: m3
description: Give Claude Code a private memory that lives on your own machine — it remembers across sessions, works fully offline, and uses the cloud only if you choose to. 100+ MCP tools: fast hybrid search, automatic chat capture, contradiction tracking, and one-command GDPR export/delete.

capture_mode.title: Chatlog capture mode
capture_mode.description: Which Claude Code hooks fire chatlog ingest. One of: both | stop | precompact | none. 'both' = Stop + PreCompact (recommended). Validated by mcp-memory at runtime; invalid values fall back to 'both'.

config_root.title: Config root — advanced
config_root.description: Where m3 keeps m3_config.toml (every other setting and root is set there: `m3 config set KEY VALUE`). Leave EMPTY for the default (~/.m3/config). Only set this if you relocated the config root; it must match M3_CONFIG_ROOT everywhere else m3 runs.
